comparison.objective: Disinfect a monitor lead with monotonic wiping strokes; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual cable holding, compliant wiping, and direction discipline versus precision tool insertion, rotary adjustment, locking, and cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Required cord/body coverage with no backward contamination and lead released on drape versus two safe locked stops. Candidate response limits are partly unspecified.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap beyond bimanual handling.
